Corollary
[Upper curvature control] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0128 1. Corollary 5.17\group normalized-ricci-flow

On a solution of the normalized Ricci flow on a compact surface, there exists a constant $C$ depending only on the initial metric such that \[ R(x,t)\le C \] for all $x$ and all $t$ in the existence interval.
